info.title: Screenshot (URL)
info.summary: Render any web page to JPEG, PNG or PDF at a chosen viewport.
info.description: Loads the page in a headless Chromium instance, waits for `delay` seconds so late-loading content settles, and saves a capture. The reply carries the URL of the saved file under `/screen/url/s/`.

post.description:
Rendering a page takes a few seconds; allow a client timeout of at least 60 seconds. Pass `download=1` to receive the file bytes directly (with `Content-Disposition: attachment`) instead of a JSON reply.

The PDF options (`orientation`, margins, paper size and `scale`) only apply when `format=pdf`. Margins and paper dimensions are in inches.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to capture.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels, 200 to 3840. Values outside the range are clamped. Default 1280.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels, 150 to 4320. Values outside the range are clamped. Default 1024.

format.description: Output type. `jpeg` (default), `png`, `webp`, or `pdf` for a paged document.

quality.description: JPEG quality from 1 to 100. Default 100. Ignored for other formats.

delay.description: Seconds to wait after the page has loaded before capturing, 0 to 15. Default 5.

download.description: Any value. Stream the file instead of returning JSON.

paperWidth.description: PDF only. Paper width in inches.

paperHeight.description: PDF only. Paper height in inches.

200.description: Metadata and the URL of the saved capture.

status.description: `"200"` on success (a string). See status codes below.

data.description: Absolute URL of the saved image or PDF, or an error message.

x-status-codes.title: OK
x-status-codes.description: The capture was saved. Note that this endpoint returns `status` as a string.

x-status-codes.title: Bad request
x-status-codes.description: `url` was missing, or `quality` was `0` for JPEG output.

x-status-codes.title: Not rendered
x-status-codes.description: The browser could not load or capture the page within the time limit.
